case_title.quote: SHARANJIT KAUR & ANR. v. STATE OF PUNJAB

number_of_accused.quote: against Sharanjit Kaur, Mukhtiar Singh, Manjit Kaur and Kirandeep @ Mandeep Kaur

accused_gender.quote: Sharanjit Kaur, Mukhtiar Singh, Manjit Kaur and Kirandeep @ Mandeep Kaur
accused_gender.reason: Names suggest both male and female accused; mixed is reasonable.

accused_occupation.reason: Occupation not stated (only 'agents' loosely mentioned generally).

victim_gender.reason: Complainant Kahan Singh and son Gurpreet Singh are male.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Agents/accused who took money from the complainant on promise of sending his son abroad (no prior relationship stated)
accused_victim_relationship.quote: on the pretext of sending his son-Gurpreet Singh to America for a permanent job
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Transactional relationship is described, so 'Not stated' is too thin.

offence_category.quote: under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.420; Punjab Panchayati Raj Act, 1994 ss.4(2), 5, 44-51, 71, 77; CrPC
statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 4(2), 5, 44-51, 71 and 77 etc. of the Punjab Panchayati Raj Act, 1994
statutory_provisions.reason: IPC s.420 is right, but the Panchayati Raj Act provisions, central to the case, are omitted.

evidence_type.quote: The complainant has also filed an affidavit highlighting all these details.
evidence_type.reason: No police report is mentioned; the cheque and affidavit are omitted.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Serious allegations; Rs. 30 lakhs duped from rustic villagers; common practice by agents
aggravating_circumstances.quote: allegations are of a serious nature and the appellants has duped of Rs. 30 lakhs
aggravating_circumstances.reason: The court does cite seriousness and the amount, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Additional Sessions Judge dismissed anticipatory bail applications on 19.04.2012 and 18.05.2012
trial_court_outcome.quote: which were dismissed vide orders dated 19.04.2012 and 18.05.2012 respectively
trial_court_outcome.reason: Broadly right, but it was the bail stage and no trial occurred.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: High Court dismissed the anticipatory bail petitions and writ petition
high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court dismissed the petitions filed by the appellants herein
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court did rule; 'Not applicable' is wrong.

final_outcome.quote: both the appeals fail and are accordingly dismissed
final_outcome.reason: Not an acquittal; appeals were dismissed.

offence_finally_established.reason: No conviction; only bail/jurisdiction was decided.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Cheating allegation of Rs. 30 lakhs; the accused sought anticipatory bail and argued the Gram Panchayat had jurisdiction
neutral_facts.quote: alleging embezzlement of Rs. 30 lakhs on the pretext of sending his son
neutral_facts.reason: Mostly accurate; the cheque and amount are right, but the allegations are stated as fact without framing them as alleged.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment states no punishment range for s.420.

attempt_completion.reason: Only allegations; no finding on completion.

number_of_offences.correct_value: 1 offence (s.420 IPC) alleged; none upheld as no trial
number_of_offences.quote: under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code
number_of_offences.reason: Upheld count of 1 is wrong; no finding of guilt.

financial_property_loss.quote: duped of Rs. 30 lakhs from the complainant

motive.correct_value: Alleged inducement to obtain Rs. 30 lakhs on pretext of foreign job
motive.quote: on the pretext of sending his son-Gurpreet Singh to America

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: No evidence assessed; the court treated allegations as serious for jurisdiction purposes only
key_evidence_accepted.quote: the offence of Section 420 IPC where the allegations are of a serious nature
key_evidence_accepted.reason: No evidence was accepted; only allegations considered.

witness_credibility.reason: No witness credibility assessed; the State merely noted non-appearance in the enquiry.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused failed to join enquiry despite being called repeatedly; cheque issued was dishonoured
post_offence_conduct.quote: the accused persons failed to join the enquiry proceedings despite being called a number of times

bail_history.correct_value: Anticipatory bail refused by Sessions Court and High Court; SLP of Manjit Kaur and Mandeep Kaur dismissed 20.07.2012; arrest stayed 21.09.2012
bail_history.quote: this Court stayed the arrest of the co-accused

trial_duration.correct_value: FIR 03.04.2012; High Court orders 23.07.2012 and 07.11.2012; SC decision 01.07.2013; no trial held
trial_duration.quote: On 03.04.2012, a First Information Report (FIR) being No. 17 was lodged
trial_duration.reason: FIR date is not offence date; no trial judgment exists.

legal_representation.quote: Heard Mr. R.K. Kapoor, learned counsel for the appellants, Mr. Ajay Kapur, learned AAG

investigation_status.correct_value: Investigation by police to continue; no report under s.173 yet noted
investigation_status.quote: the investigation is to be conducted by the police authorities only
investigation_status.reason: No s.173 report filed; the transfer description is a general conclusion.

appeal_history.correct_value: Sessions Court dismissed anticipatory bail; High Court dismissed 03.05.2012, 23.07.2012, writ 07.11.2012; SC dismissed SLP of co-accused 20.07.2012; present appeals dismissed
appeal_history.quote: Vide order dated 20.07.2012, this Court, dismissed the same.
appeal_history.reason: Largely right but omits the writ petition and earlier SC dismissal.

prosecution_argument.quote: the prosecuting authority is entitled to proceed under the provisions of the IPC

defence_argument.quote: give complete powers to the Gram Panchayat to take cognizance of criminal cases

legal_principle_applied.correct_value: Gram Panchayat jurisdiction is additional and cannot oust police investigation; Gram Panchayat has no jurisdiction until investigation completes and the case is transferred under s.45
legal_principle_applied.quote: Till the stage of completion of investigation, Gram Panchayat has no jurisdiction at all.
legal_principle_applied.reason: Core principle is right, but the wording is garbled.

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: Giani Ram, Baldeo Singh, Kartar Singh referred to; Chhotey Lal, Bhim Sen, Shobharam, Meena Ram held inapplicable
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Lists cases that the court held inapplicable as relied upon.

sentencing_rationale.correct_value: No sentence imposed; the court held that the offence should be tried by the regular criminal court
sentencing_rationale.quote: should be tried by the regular criminal court only and not by the Gram Panchayat

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Serious nature of allegations; Rs. 30 lakhs duped; rustic villagers duped by agents
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: allegations are of a serious nature and the appellants has duped of Rs. 30 lakhs
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The court relied on seriousness in deciding forum.

other_sentence_order.quote: Interim protection granted earlier shall stand vacated.
other_sentence_order.reason: There was an order vacating interim protection.
